stories.summary: Philip and Kim English and two of their children - nine-year-old Jayden and 12-year-old Callum - died after their home in Birch Avenue, on the outskirts of Waterford was set on fire earlier this month. stories.title: White House says Melania Trump helped broker Oleshky ceasefire
stories.summary: The White House announced that First Lady Melania Trump secured a cease‑fire between Russian and Ukrainian forces in the occupied city of Oleshky. The truce, intended to allow evacuation of civilians and delivery of aid, was said to start on 29 October, with both sides agreeing to halt firing at 01:00 GMT on 27 October. Oleshky has been under Russian control since February 2022 and has faced severe shortages of food, medicine and water.
stories.why: The pause could enable humanitarian assistance and safe evacuation of residents in a city facing critical shortages.

stories.title: Study finds Grok favors Republicans, OpenAI model favors Democrats in forced‑choice test
stories.summary: A Convovo study asked SpaceXAI’s Grok 4.7 and OpenAI’s GPT‑6.1 Sol, via their developer APIs, to name a single candidate for upcoming midterm races without hedging. Grok recommended the Republican candidate in 92% of responses, while GPT‑6.1 Sol chose the Democrat in 97%; the two models agreed on less than 10% of nearly 500 races. Consumer‑facing apps for both services refused to answer the same prompt.
stories.why: Shows that AI models accessed through APIs can display partisan bias, which may impact developers and users seeking political guidance.
stories.previousTitle: Study finds Grok API leans Republican, OpenAI API leans Democrat in forced vote question
stories.previousSummary: A Convovo study asked the developer APIs of SpaceXAI’s Grok 4.7 and OpenAI’s GPT‑6.1 Sol to name a single candidate for upcoming midterm races without hedging. Grok recommended the Republican in 92 % of responses, while GPT‑6.1 Sol chose the Democrat in 97 %, and the models agreed on less than 10 % of nearly 500 races. The consumer chatbots for both services refused to answer, and OpenAI said the API test does not reflect typical user experience.

stories.title: India and Russia set $100 billion trade goal for 2030
stories.summary: Indian Ambassador Vinay Kumar said India and Russia will work to raise bilateral trade to $100 billion by 2030. Prime Minister Narendra Modi and President Vladimir Putin endorsed the goal during their meeting at the BRICS summit in New Delhi, pledging to boost mutual investments and to train Indian specialists for Russian industries.
stories.why: Reaching the target would deepen economic ties and shift trade balances between the two nations.
